title: Archon Context7 Capability Pack
task: Make Context7 docs, skills, MCP profile, UI-lab guidance, Agentic Search guidance, prompt patterns, and Git/story mapping visible to Archon capability planning.
blockedTools: Context7 live MCP calls without CONTEXT7_API_KEY or OAuth-backed client config
fallback: Use installed Context7 CLI skills and captured docs evidence; keep Context7 output advisory until recorded in local artifacts.
nextAction: run context7-capability-forge-loop to refresh skill install evidence, capability profiles, Forge packet, and validator output
guardrails: Forge consumes catalog, registry, and evidence only; it must not call live Context7, MCP, shell, network, Graphify, or Agentic Search tools.
Context7 MCP profile stores only environment variable references.
Context7 output remains advisory unless captured by this repo as evidence.
No custom UI-lab MCP; UI-lab authority remains shadcn registry, Storybook, and Playwright evidence.
Installed skills may guide prompts and implementation, but they do not override AGENTS.md, BMAD gates, or Archon workflow guardrails.
